statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted are I49.9, I25.10, and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has an unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance (I49.9)
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of the cardiac rhythm disturbance
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The appeal requests that the precertification requirement be waived
